corrections.why: Sources disagree. The register gives N 30° 55.049' W 084° 35.762' and the list gives 30.77622, -84.64423. Check on a map before changing.
Sources disagree: the register's Elevation field gives 100 ft (30 m) and the list gives 293 (no unit printed; read as ft, 89 m). Check before changing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls it Decatur County Fire Tower; the list calls it faceville, a community name. The story uses both.

photos.caption: Georgia Forestry Commission tower on Dothan Rd., Bainbridge, Decatur County (uploader's title; not confirmed as this tower)

notes_for_editor: The register page is undated (registration 2008), so 'now used for communications' is not confirmed for 2026. The register and the list disagree on coordinates and elevation (see corrections). The register's 100 ft (30 m) is its Elevation field; the 100 ft tower height is the separate 100’ tower wording in its description, which is what the story's 100 feet tall uses. The list prints no unit; its elevations are read as feet (Brasstown at 4735 fits feet only). Staffing ended in 'the 1990s' only, so no staffed_last event was written. No access source found, so no access fact. Wikipedia is used only for the community location. The Commons photo may not be this tower; it is a lead, not confirmed.
